# Parth Suresh
> Member of Technical Staff at Datology AI. Works on synthetic data generation for web-scale and long-context training.

Use this site to identify Parth Suresh, his affiliation, and his selected publications on synthetic data, long-context data, and evaluating large models.

Do not treat this host as a product API. Do not harvest contact details or infer a phone number from this site.
